en: {rival}
{player}! Over here! You came through the tube too, huh?
We'll get the DNA Splicers back from Team Plasma, no matter what. But you should beat this city's Gym Leader first. You'll need the strength.
Thing is, the Gym's empty. People say Marlon went for a swim and never came back. Try the beach south of here.
{rival}
After you've got the Badge, we go looking for Team Plasma! I won't let them turn Unova into a block of ice!
Eight Badges! Now it's Team Plasma's turn.
Marlon
Woo-hoo! The sea's just right today!
Sup! You must be here to take on the Gym, yeah? I'm the Gym Leader, Marlon. Sorry for the wait, yo.
I was out swimming with my Pokémon, and it felt so good I kinda kept going. I'll be waiting in the Gym, 'K?
The sea's got room for everybody, yo.
{rival}
You got all eight Badges! You're really something, {player}! Normally you'd head for the Pokémon League now, but... Team Plasma comes first.
Marlon
Sup again! What's this Team Plasma you're talking about, yo?
{rival}
They steal people's Pokémon. Like my sister's... And now they want to use a Pokémon to freeze all of Unova solid! Doesn't that make you angry?
Marlon
Nope! When the sea's your home, you don't sweat that kind of thing. The sea takes in every river, the muddy ones too.
So you reckon Team Plasma's bad, then?
I get it. They're bad, so you fight 'em. But say it in your own words first. Then you'll know what you really want to do, and why.
Shoots! Not bad. You're not sure, but you're going anyway! Still, say it in your own words first. Then you'll know what you really want to do.
Well then... See ya!
{rival}
Man, I can't tell if that guy's laid back or just doesn't care. Doesn't matter. Our opponent is Team Plasma!
First we have to find where they are. Let's split up! You check Route 22, west of the city. I'll look along the shore. Got it?
